links.outcome: Citation accuracy and hallucinated references in generative AI outputs
links.effect: Perplexity AI had the best citation accuracy; ChatGPT4 and Claude required manual verification of citations; hallucinated references persist as a risk.
links.quote: Perplexity AI demonstrated the best citation accuracy, while ChatGPT4 and Claude excelled in content summarization but required manual verification of citations.

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI to speed literature review and guideline comparison (up to 70% time reduction vs PubMed searches in simulated trials)
Clinician AI literacy for literature-review use

screen.reason: Evaluates generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) using structured clinical prompts and simulated trials to compare their literature review and guideline comparison capabilities in perinatology.
